name: Vicor Corporation
blurb: Vicor Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, and markets modular power components and power systems for converting electrical power in electrically powered devices. The company offers a range of brick-format DC-DC converters, complementary components for AC line rectification and filtering, and input/output voltage products. Vicor serves customers in the United States, Europe, Asia Pacific, and internationally, and is known for its high-performance power management solutions.
recent: As of May 6, 2026, Vicor's stock closed at $280.34, up 5.39% on the day, with a 52-week range of $39.64 to $293.95. The company reported strong financials with revenue of $426.70M (up 15.6% year-over-year) and net income of $136.68M (up 490.6%). Analysts have a Strong Buy rating with a price target of $217.50, though the stock trades above that level.
